decision_method.asr: Equal-language CER(ZH/JA/KO)/WER(EN/ES/FR/DE) macro; complete100/subset, zero failures, every-language RTF budget.
decision_method.voice: Coverage and licence first, all observed primary first-sentence starts <=2s, each full briefRTF<1; rank primary five-sentence back-ASR equal-language macro; ties prefer lower mean briefRTF.
decision_method.limits: ASR limits are survey assumptions, not product SLAs. Warm sentence PCM readiness is not cold-start or device playback.
